Message.SourceString: Walk my path, tread the ground.
Message.LocalizedString: Walk my path, tread the ground.

Message.SourceString: A key will unlock my lost and found.
Message.LocalizedString: A key will unlock my lost and found.

Message.SourceString: Take the straw out of your pockets so I can give you the key.
Message.LocalizedString: Take the straw out of your pockets so I can give you the key.

Message.SourceString: I buried it… where my wooden post last broke the ground.
Message.LocalizedString: I buried it… where my wooden post last broke the ground.

Message.SourceString: Memory falls out of me like straw.
Message.LocalizedString: Memory falls out of me like straw.

Message.SourceString: You do not have the space to receive your reward. You will need to make room in your backpack.
Message.LocalizedString: You do not have the space to receive your reward. You will need to make room in your backpack.

Message.SourceString: I remember... I was not always like this.
Message.LocalizedString: I remember... I was not always like this.

Message.SourceString: I walked these fields. I breathed. I think I even had a name.
Message.LocalizedString: I walked these fields. I breathed. I think I even had a name.

Message.SourceString: I buried it… where my wooden post last broke the ground.
Message.LocalizedString: I buried it… where my wooden post last broke the ground.
